نندعس (form VII)
# نَنْدَعِسُ (nandaʕisu) /nan.da.ʕi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
# نَنْدَعِسَ (nandaʕisa) /nan.da.ʕi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
# نَنْدَعِسْ (nandaʕis) /nan.da.ʕis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
